import json
import time
import statistics
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel

PROJECT = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier"
BASE_MODEL = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
CLS_CKPT = f"{PROJECT}/checkpoints/best"
CWM_CKPT = f"{PROJECT}/checkpoints_cwm/best"
CLS_DATA = f"{PROJECT}/data/test.jsonl"
CWM_DATA = f"{PROJECT}/data/cwm_test.jsonl"
N_SAMPLES = 50
N_WARMUP = 3
DEVICE = "cpu"

CLS_SYSTEM = "You are a code verifier. Given a code snippet and a test case, predict whether the test will pass or fail."
CWM_SYSTEM = "You are a code execution simulator. Given a code snippet and a test case, predict the execution result."

def load_jsonl(path, n):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f][:n]

def detect_thinking(tok):
    try:
        tok.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], tokenize=False, enable_thinking=False)
        return {"enable_thinking": False}
    except TypeError:
        return {}

def build_ids(tok, code, test, system, user_suffix, tmpl_kw, max_len=2048):
    user_msg = f"## Code\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\n{user_suffix}"
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}]
    ids = tok.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, **tmpl_kw)
    return ids[:max_len]

def load_model(ckpt_path):
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ckpt_path, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left")
    if tok.pad_token is None:
        tok.pad_token = tok.eos_token
    base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(BASE_MODEL, torch_dtype=torch.float32, trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation="sdpa")
    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, ckpt_path)
    model.eval()
    model.to(DEVICE)
    return model, tok

def measure_single(model, tok, samples, system, user_suffix, max_new_tokens, tmpl_kw):
    eos_ids = [tok.eos_token_id]
    im_end = tok.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|im_end|>")
    if im_end is not None and im_end != tok.unk_token_id:
        eos_ids.append(im_end)

    latencies = []
    output_token_counts = []
    input_token_counts = []
    generated_texts = []

    for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
        ids = build_ids(tok, sample["code"], sample["test"], system, user_suffix, tmpl_kw)
        input_len = len(ids)
        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=DEVICE)

        with torch.inference_mode():
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            out = model.generate(input_ids=input_ids, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, do_sample=False, eos_token_id=eos_ids)
            t1 = time.perf_counter()

        gen_ids = out[0][input_len:]
        gen_text = tok.decode(gen_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
        n_out = len(gen_ids)
        elapsed_ms = (t1 - t0) * 1000

        if i < N_WARMUP:
            continue

        latencies.append(elapsed_ms)
        output_token_counts.append(n_out)
        input_token_counts.append(input_len)
        generated_texts.append(gen_text)

        if (i - N_WARMUP) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"  sample {i - N_WARMUP}/{len(samples) - N_WARMUP}: {elapsed_ms:.0f}ms, out_tokens={n_out}, text='{gen_text[:60]}'")

    return {
        "latency_ms": {
            "mean": round(statistics.mean(latencies), 1),
            "median": round(statistics.median(latencies), 1),
            "std": round(statistics.stdev(latencies), 1) if len(latencies) > 1 else 0,
            "min": round(min(latencies), 1),
            "max": round(max(latencies), 1),
        },
        "output_tokens": {
            "mean": round(statistics.mean(output_token_counts), 1),
            "median": round(statistics.median(output_token_counts), 1),
            "min": min(output_token_counts),
            "max": max(output_token_counts),
            "p95": round(sorted(output_token_counts)[int(len(output_token_counts) * 0.95)], 1),
        },
        "input_tokens": {
            "mean": round(statistics.mean(input_token_counts), 1),
            "median": round(statistics.median(input_token_counts), 1),
        },
        "throughput_samples_per_sec": round(len(latencies) / (sum(latencies) / 1000), 3),
        "n_measured": len(latencies),
        "sample_texts": generated_texts[:5],
    }

def main():
    print("=== Loading Classification model ===")
    cls_model, cls_tok = load_model(CLS_CKPT)
    cls_tmpl = detect_thinking(cls_tok)
    cls_data = load_jsonl(CLS_DATA, N_SAMPLES + N_WARMUP)
    print(f"Loaded {len(cls_data)} samples for classification")

    print("\n=== Measuring Classification (max_new_tokens=10) ===")
    cls_results = measure_single(cls_model, cls_tok, cls_data, CLS_SYSTEM, "Will this test pass or fail?", 10, cls_tmpl)
    print(f"Classification done: mean={cls_results['latency_ms']['mean']}ms, mean_out_tokens={cls_results['output_tokens']['mean']}")

    del cls_model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
    import gc; gc.collect()

    print("\n=== Loading CWM model ===")
    cwm_model, cwm_tok = load_model(CWM_CKPT)
    cwm_tmpl = detect_thinking(cwm_tok)
    cwm_data = load_jsonl(CWM_DATA, N_SAMPLES + N_WARMUP)
    print(f"Loaded {len(cwm_data)} samples for CWM")

    print("\n=== Measuring CWM Generation (max_new_tokens=128) ===")
    cwm_results = measure_single(cwm_model, cwm_tok, cwm_data, CWM_SYSTEM, "What is the execution result?", 128, cwm_tmpl)
    print(f"CWM done: mean={cwm_results['latency_ms']['mean']}ms, mean_out_tokens={cwm_results['output_tokens']['mean']}")

    ratio = cwm_results["latency_ms"]["mean"] / cls_results["latency_ms"]["mean"] if cls_results["latency_ms"]["mean"] > 0 else float("inf")
    token_ratio = cwm_results["output_tokens"]["mean"] / cls_results["output_tokens"]["mean"] if cls_results["output_tokens"]["mean"] > 0 else float("inf")

    summary = {
        "device": DEVICE,
        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "n_measured_per_method": N_SAMPLES,
        "n_warmup": N_WARMUP,
        "classification": cls_results,
        "cwm_generation": cwm_results,
        "comparison": {
            "latency_ratio_cwm_over_cls": round(ratio, 2),
            "output_token_ratio_cwm_over_cls": round(token_ratio, 2),
            "cls_output_tokens_mean": cls_results["output_tokens"]["mean"],
            "cwm_output_tokens_mean": cwm_results["output_tokens"]["mean"],
        },
    }

    out_path = f"{PROJECT}/inference_cost_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\n=== Results saved to {out_path} ===")
    print(f"\nLatency ratio (CWM/CLS): {ratio:.2f}x")
    print(f"Output token ratio (CWM/CLS): {token_ratio:.2f}x")
    print(f"CLS: {cls_results['latency_ms']['mean']:.0f}ms/sample, {cls_results['output_tokens']['mean']:.1f} tokens")
    print(f"CWM: {cwm_results['latency_ms']['mean']:.0f}ms/sample, {cwm_results['output_tokens']['mean']:.1f} tokens")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import time
import statistics
import gc
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel

PROJECT = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier"
BASE_MODEL = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
CLS_CKPT = f"{PROJECT}/checkpoints/best"
CWM_CKPT = f"{PROJECT}/checkpoints_cwm/best"
CLS_DATA = f"{PROJECT}/data/test.jsonl"
CWM_DATA = f"{PROJECT}/data/cwm_test.jsonl"
N_SAMPLES = 10
N_WARMUP = 1
DEVICE = "cpu"
DTYPE = torch.bfloat16

CLS_SYSTEM = "You are a code verifier. Given a code snippet and a test case, predict whether the test will pass or fail."
CWM_SYSTEM = "You are a code execution simulator. Given a code snippet and a test case, predict the execution result."

def load_jsonl(path, n):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f][:n]

def detect_thinking(tok):
    try:
        tok.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], tokenize=False, enable_thinking=False)
        return {"enable_thinking": False}
    except TypeError:
        return {}

def build_ids(tok, code, test, system, user_suffix, tmpl_kw, max_len=2048):
    user_msg = f"## Code\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\n{user_suffix}"
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}]
    ids = tok.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, **tmpl_kw)
    return ids[:max_len]

def load_model(ckpt_path):
    print(f"  Loading tokenizer from {ckpt_path}")
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ckpt_path, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left")
    if tok.pad_token is None:
        tok.pad_token = tok.eos_token

    print(f"  Loading base model {BASE_MODEL} (bfloat16, CPU)")
    base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        BASE_MODEL, dtype=DTYPE, trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation="sdpa"
    )
    print(f"  Loading LoRA adapter from {ckpt_path}")
    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, ckpt_path)
    model.eval()
    model.to(DEVICE)
    print("  Model loaded.")
    return model, tok

def measure_single(model, tok, samples, system, user_suffix, max_new_tokens, tmpl_kw):
    eos_ids = [tok.eos_token_id]
    im_end = tok.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|im_end|>")
    if im_end is not None and im_end != tok.unk_token_id:
        eos_ids.append(im_end)

    latencies = []
    output_token_counts = []
    input_token_counts = []
    generated_texts = []
    prefill_times = []
    decode_times = []

    for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
        ids = build_ids(tok, sample["code"], sample["test"], system, user_suffix, tmpl_kw)
        input_len = len(ids)
        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=DEVICE)

        is_warmup = i < N_WARMUP
        tag = "WARMUP" if is_warmup else f"SAMPLE-{i - N_WARMUP}"

        with torch.inference_mode():
            # Measure prefill (first token)
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            out = model.generate(
                input_ids=input_ids, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                do_sample=False, eos_token_id=eos_ids
            )
            t1 = time.perf_counter()

        gen_ids = out[0][input_len:]
        gen_text = tok.decode(gen_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
        n_out = len(gen_ids)
        elapsed_ms = (t1 - t0) * 1000

        print(f"  [{tag}] {elapsed_ms:.0f}ms, in={input_len} out={n_out} tokens, text='{gen_text[:80]}'", flush=True)

        if not is_warmup:
            latencies.append(elapsed_ms)
            output_token_counts.append(n_out)
            input_token_counts.append(input_len)
            generated_texts.append(gen_text)

    return {
        "latency_ms": {
            "mean": round(statistics.mean(latencies), 1),
            "median": round(statistics.median(latencies), 1),
            "std": round(statistics.stdev(latencies), 1) if len(latencies) > 1 else 0,
            "min": round(min(latencies), 1),
            "max": round(max(latencies), 1),
        },
        "output_tokens": {
            "mean": round(statistics.mean(output_token_counts), 1),
            "median": round(statistics.median(output_token_counts), 1),
            "min": min(output_token_counts),
            "max": max(output_token_counts),
            "p95": sorted(output_token_counts)[int(len(output_token_counts) * 0.95)],
        },
        "input_tokens": {
            "mean": round(statistics.mean(input_token_counts), 1),
            "median": round(statistics.median(input_token_counts), 1),
        },
        "throughput_samples_per_sec": round(len(latencies) / (sum(latencies) / 1000), 4),
        "n_measured": len(latencies),
        "sample_texts": generated_texts[:5],
    }

def compute_token_stats_full(data_path, tok, tmpl_kw, system, user_suffix):
    """Compute input token length stats across full dataset (no model inference needed)."""
    data = load_jsonl(data_path, 9999)
    input_lens = []
    for sample in data:
        ids = build_ids(tok, sample["code"], sample["test"], system, user_suffix, tmpl_kw)
        input_lens.append(len(ids))
    return {
        "n": len(input_lens),
        "mean": round(statistics.mean(input_lens), 1),

        "min": min(input_lens),
        "max": max(input_lens),
        "p95": sorted(input_lens)[int(len(input_lens) * 0.95)],
    }

def compute_cwm_target_token_stats(data_path, tok):
    """Compute target token length stats for CWM dataset."""
    data = load_jsonl(data_path, 9999)
    tok_lens = [len(tok.encode(d["target"])) for d in data]
    return {
        "n": len(tok_lens),
        "mean": round(statistics.mean(tok_lens), 1),
        "median": round(statistics.median(tok_lens), 1),
        "min": min(tok_lens),
        "max": max(tok_lens),
        "p95": sorted(tok_lens)[int(len(tok_lens) * 0.95)],
    }

def main():
    total_start = time.perf_counter()

    print("=" * 60)
    print("INFERENCE COST MEASUREMENT: Classification vs CWM")
    print("=" * 60)

    # --- Classification ---
    print("\n=== Loading Classification model ===")
    cls_model, cls_tok = load_model(CLS_CKPT)
    cls_tmpl = detect_thinking(cls_tok)
    cls_data = load_jsonl(CLS_DATA, N_SAMPLES + N_WARMUP)

    print(f"\n=== Classification: input token stats (full dataset) ===")
    cls_input_stats = compute_token_stats_full(CLS_DATA, cls_tok, cls_tmpl, CLS_SYSTEM, "Will this test pass or fail?")
    print(f"  {cls_input_stats}")

    print(f"\n=== Measuring Classification (max_new_tokens=10, {N_SAMPLES} samples) ===")
    cls_results = measure_single(cls_model, cls_tok, cls_data, CLS_SYSTEM, "Will this test pass or fail?", 10, cls_tmpl)
    print(f"\n  CLS DONE: mean_latency={cls_results['latency_ms']['mean']}ms, mean_out_tokens={cls_results['output_tokens']['mean']}")

    del cls_model
    gc.collect()

    # --- CWM ---
    print("\n=== Loading CWM model ===")
    cwm_model, cwm_tok = load_model(CWM_CKPT)
    cwm_tmpl = detect_thinking(cwm_tok)
    cwm_data = load_jsonl(CWM_DATA, N_SAMPLES + N_WARMUP)

    print(f"\n=== CWM: input token stats (full dataset) ===")
    cwm_input_stats = compute_token_stats_full(CWM_DATA, cwm_tok, cwm_tmpl, CWM_SYSTEM, "What is the execution result?")
    print(f"  {cwm_input_stats}")

    print(f"\n=== CWM: target token stats (full dataset) ===")
    cwm_target_stats = compute_cwm_target_token_stats(CWM_DATA, cwm_tok)
    print(f"  {cwm_target_stats}")

    print(f"\n=== Measuring CWM Generation (max_new_tokens=128, {N_SAMPLES} samples) ===")
    cwm_results = measure_single(cwm_model, cwm_tok, cwm_data, CWM_SYSTEM, "What is the execution result?", 128, cwm_tmpl)
    print(f"\n  CWM DONE: mean_latency={cwm_results['latency_ms']['mean']}ms, mean_out_tokens={cwm_results['output_tokens']['mean']}")

    # --- Comparison ---
    cls_lat = cls_results["latency_ms"]["mean"]
    cwm_lat = cwm_results["latency_ms"]["mean"]
    lat_ratio = round(cwm_lat / cls_lat, 2) if cls_lat > 0 else float("inf")
    tok_ratio = round(cwm_results["output_tokens"]["mean"] / cls_results["output_tokens"]["mean"], 2) if cls_results["output_tokens"]["mean"] > 0 else float("inf")

    summary = {
        "device": DEVICE,
        "dtype": str(DTYPE),
        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "n_measured_per_method": N_SAMPLES,
        "n_warmup": N_WARMUP,
        "classification": {
            **cls_results,
            "input_token_stats_full_dataset": cls_input_stats,
        },
        "cwm_generation": {
            **cwm_results,
            "input_token_stats_full_dataset": cwm_input_stats,
            "target_token_stats_full_dataset": cwm_target_stats,
        },
        "comparison": {
            "latency_ratio_cwm_over_cls": lat_ratio,
            "output_token_ratio_cwm_over_cls": tok_ratio,
            "cls_output_tokens_mean": cls_results["output_tokens"]["mean"],
            "cwm_output_tokens_mean": cwm_results["output_tokens"]["mean"],
            "cls_latency_ms_mean": cls_lat,
            "cwm_latency_ms_mean": cwm_lat,
        },
    }

    out_path = f"{PROJECT}/inference_cost_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)

    total_sec = time.perf_counter() - total_start

    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"RESULTS SUMMARY")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"Device: {DEVICE}, dtype: {DTYPE}")
    print(f"Samples measured: {N_SAMPLES} per method, {N_WARMUP} warmup")
    print(f"")
    print(f"Classification:")
    print(f"  Latency: {cls_lat:.0f}ms/sample (median={cls_results['latency_ms']['median']:.0f})")
    print(f"  Output tokens: mean={cls_results['output_tokens']['mean']}, median={cls_results['output_tokens']['median']}")
    print(f"  Throughput: {cls_results['throughput_samples_per_sec']:.4f} samples/sec")
    print(f"")
    print(f"CWM Generation:")
    print(f"  Latency: {cwm_lat:.0f}ms/sample (median={cwm_results['latency_ms']['median']:.0f})")
    print(f"  Output tokens: mean={cwm_results['output_tokens']['mean']}, median={cwm_results['output_tokens']['median']}")
    print(f"  Throughput: {cwm_results['throughput_samples_per_sec']:.4f} samples/sec")
    print(f"")
    print(f"CWM target tokens (full dataset): mean={cwm_target_stats['mean']}, p50={cwm_target_stats['median']}, p95={cwm_target_stats['p95']}, max={cwm_target_stats['max']}")
    print(f"")
    print(f"Comparison:")
    print(f"  Latency ratio (CWM/CLS): {lat_ratio}x")
    print(f"  Output token ratio (CWM/CLS): {tok_ratio}x")
    print(f"")
    print(f"Total time: {total_sec:.0f}s")
    print(f"Results saved to {out_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

**Classification vs CWM Generation Inference Cost (CPU, bfloat16, Qwen3-4B)**

| Metric | Classification | CWM Generation | Ratio (CWM/CLS) |
|--------|---------------|----------------|-------------------|
| Output tokens (mean) | 2.0 | 6.2 | 3.1x |
| Latency (mean) | 9,761 ms | 10,612 ms | 1.09x |


| Throughput | 0.1024 samples/s | 0.0942 samples/s | — |

The latency difference is surprisingly small on CPU because prefill dominates the computation — both approaches process similar input lengths around 260 tokens, and CWM's extra decode steps barely register against that prefill cost. On GPU, I'd expect a larger ratio since prefill becomes much faster with batching, making the per-token decode overhead more significant. Looking at the CWM target distribution across the full dataset, the mean is 4.7 tokens with a median of 5, though it can spike to 28 in edge cases.

The outputs themselves are quite short — mostly pass/fail messages like "PASS: test completed successfully" or error strings. I've saved all the inference cost results to the output file and I'm ready to report these findings.
